VideoGeneration.//GoogleFlowEnabled: Shows the 'dựng bằng Google Flow' choice in the wizard's Generate step.
VideoGeneration.//ImageToVideoEnabled: Set true ONLY if Llm:Gemini:VideoModel supports an image first frame. veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview does NOT (text-to-video only); leave false so no per-clip anchor image is generated.

//Credits: Daily AI-generation credit budget for the core pipeline. Reference plan: 50/day = 1x Fast (20) + 3x Lite (10). Allocation is dynamic (VideoAllocationPlanner decides how many of each tier); these are only the per-unit costs and the retry cap.
//Flow: Maps the abstract Fast/Lite video tier onto concrete provider model ids. Keeps the tier concept provider-agnostic.
//Pricing: Estimates used for the pre-generation cost/time panel and for budget tracking - NOT authoritative billing. Verify against https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing.

Pricing.//VideoTierRates: Per-clip Veo pricing. Fast ~$3.20 / 8s, Lite ~$0.64 / 8s. The Step 5 cost estimate sums each clip at its own tier.
Pricing.//SecondsPerClipGeneration: Wall-clock WAIT per Veo clip, not playback length. Times the clip count = the 'time to build' estimate.

//Publishing: Step 7 direct publishing/scheduling. Client keys/secrets and TokenEncryptionKey come from env vars (see .env.example) - never commit real values. When a platform's key/secret is blank it shows as 'not configured' and no job is created for it.
//Captions:Segmentation: Semantic caption cue sizing - 3-6 words, never 1-2, max 2 lines. Punctuation guides but does not control the split.
//Timeline: Narration audio is the timeline authority. Scene length = its narration length (clamped); silent scenes get NoNarrationSceneSeconds, never filler.
//Audio:Mix: Final mix: narration bed, music auto-ducked under narration (sidechaincompress), low ambience, delayed SFX, fade in/out - no hard cuts.
